feature_contract.goal: Prevent projected car/rival rank markers from borrowing the wrong physical Draw or fixed-function vertex layout across native left/right R84 eye submissions, preserving car-relative original Calc3D2D anchors and fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 physical projected-rank Draw transaction only. Keep original direct/queued sprite sources, fixedfn FVF 0x142 and original mono on uncertain state; never affect world shaders, +TIME/GOAL, lens/SkyGlow, gamepad/FFB or R26_SAFE.
trace_stages: Original car/rival Calc3D2D marker attaches view-space anchor to rank clip and sprani SpriteNode.
R84 R30 samples queue owner, pose, shader, physical top-level Draw serial and fixed-function FVF before native left primitive.
Immediately after original left primitive, R30 re-proves same exact node/anchor/draw/FVF before right-eye projection; changed producer requires right-eye failure and mono safety.
subcomponents: Lock Draw serial and original fixed-function FVF to the exact rank GPU command across native left submission.
Preserve queued/direct and fixedfn/shader positive paths; fail closed when nested rank draws, unknown serial, FVF changes, node/pose/shader changes or malformed anchor.
Compiled C++ physical source smoke, Python destructive rank mutation verification and exact-SHA active game/host/package, Domain, HUD and Full Source gates.

diagnosis.root_cause: PhysicalRankSource retained node/anchor/pose/shader across native LEFT but omitted the actual top-level Draw serial and FVF. Reentrant LEFT work can issue a different command with identical node/token/pose/shader while the subsequent RIGHT pass still accepts the stale rank source.
alternatives_rejected: Do not promote generic 2D nodes to world markers, relax existing queue proof or duplicate the native left Draw.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: Source-backed missing physical identity guard; HMD optical behavior not measured; runtime remains UNTESTED.
